The '''''Blacken''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] which arrived minutes after the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Frigate]] [[Enforcer (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|Enforcer]] as [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper Transport]] [[Raider (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|Raider]] were escaping after stealing Imperial food supplies.
